Name: Jurassic Mod
Author: marblestar
Description:
This mod allows you to have how many dinosaurs you want in your farm (of course that there's a limit about how much animals you can own. the mod doesn't change that).
Want to transform Rex, your dog, into a dinosaur? Go ahead!
Want to transform all the animals into dinosaurs? Just put the files in the Animals folder.

The art was done by [b]ConcernedApe[/b], except for the Velociraptor, which I created.

Version I:
Dinosaurs have the original color (green).
Version II:
Dinosaurs with different colors.

Enjoy.

-EpicAdventure.
